items.title: Composer Host admission, draft retention, and prompt retry deduplication
items.adaptation: One ordinary send occupies a sending phase. The editor stays read-only and the draft, quotes, and attachments stay put until the Host accepts. Acceptance clears the draft. Refusal or failure returns the same document to editing. The transcript echo is published only after acceptance. commands.prompt reserves the requestId synchronously before any attachment await and shares that one admission with a concurrent retry.

chosen.change: Replace detached enter-time commit with one sending phase. commit-draft runs only when sink settlement is ok. A failed sink leaves the document unchanged. Do not copy the tag file: it also threads quote occurrences. Add those fields in RC1-05, on this phase.
Execute the sending-phase effects. Do not clear the editor before the Host result. Keep fork attachment ownership until acceptance.
Add the sending phase and sink settlement to the existing input union. Do not import tag-only analytics fields.

Treat Host acceptance, including an inbox row that already carries the requestId, as success. A refusal leaves draft attachments registered. Do not release them on a receipt error after the Host has the message.

Publish the local echo and the blank-to-engaging edge only after acceptance. A rejected first prompt leaves the session blank. Keep the current subagent branch that mints a new requestId at the continuable prompt call. Do not copy the tag branch that reuses requestId.
Document acceptance versus echo publication on the existing prompt and beginSubmission methods. Do not replace the contract file.
Keep pending submissions out of the published snapshot until accepted. The requestId field stays.

Reserve requestId before resolveAgent returns to the caller and before admitPromptContent. Concurrent calls with the same id share one promise. Success leaves the user message in the inbox or log; a later call returns accepted and does not enqueue again. Failure drops the reservation so one retry can enqueue once. Keep selectionFor for the image check. Do not move source construction to the remote and do not copy the tag prompt.

proposedFilenames.role: Two overlapping prompt calls with one requestId enqueue one user message. The second waiter sees the first result. A failed attempt can be retried once. Two different requestIds both enqueue. An id already in the inbox returns accepted and does not add a second message.
